papers.title: Representation Redistribution in Sparse Autoencoders
papers.summary: Sparse autoencoders decompose language model activations into sparse features, and the redistribution sensitivity score identifies recurring feature changes that contribute to downstream readout failures without equating representation change with failure.

papers.title: EnvLunch: The Environment as a Free Lunch for Learning to Interact
papers.summary: EnvLunch leverages executable environments to generate verifiable training trajectories without human annotations, improving agent performance and reducing labeled data requirements for downstream tasks.

papers.title: Can Test-Time Memory Evolution Outperform Test-Time Training for Scientific Discovery?
papers.summary: Test-Time Memory Evolution updates external memory without changing model weights to guide scientific discovery more efficiently than test-time training.

papers.title: Did the Model Use That? Counterfactual Training Boosts Self-Attribution in Language Models
papers.summary: CREDIT improves language model self-attribution of external information via counterfactual training, reducing false acknowledgment of non-influential sources.

papers.title: Rethinking Verification in Agent Harnesses
papers.summary: Verification strategies for agent harnesses—spanning instructions, reminders, gates, and independent review—show that independent critic review improves accuracy with minimal cost increases, guiding practical test-time scaling design.
